outcome: Factors influencing willingness to undergo labor after cesarean
cohort: 438 pregnant individuals with one prior cesarean delivery (CD) who attended their antenatal examination at a tertiary hospital in southern China
finding: A high preference for labor after cesarean (LAC) was found among pregnant individuals without contraindications before delivery in southern China.
mod_finding: Neonatal wellbeing with the prior CD was an independent influencing factor affecting willingness to access LAC in the subsequent pregnancy.
